description: The effective log files and GoAccess settings: each value, the fields an environment variable sets, and when a change takes effect

write_log_files.description: Write the error and stream log files; forced on by GOA (env LOGROTATE)

log_format.description: Format of the access and stream log files: classic (space separated) or json, one object per line with the same fields (env NGINX_LOG_FORMAT)

tls_handshake_log.description: Write failed and rejected TLS handshakes of the default site and the admin UI to /data/nginx/logs/tls.log at level info, while the log files are on (env NGINX_TLS_HANDSHAKE_LOG)

goaccess.description: GoAccess report (env GOA); applies after a container restart

goaccess_keep_days.description: GoAccess keeps report data for this many days (--keep-last), 1 to 366; null when a GOACLA from the env has no --keep-last. Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_anonymize.description: Anonymize visitor IPs in the GoAccess report: off or the --anonymize-level. Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_drop_query_strings.description: Drop query strings from the URLs in the GoAccess report (--no-query-string). Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_real_os.description: Full operating system versions in the GoAccess report (--real-os). Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

goaccess_resolve_hosts.description: Resolve visitor host names in the GoAccess report (--with-output-resolver). Applies after a container restart, locked by GOACLA

locked.description: Fields that cannot be changed because an environment variable sets them, or forces them (see locked_by and locked_reason). A save ignores them (read only)

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the environment variable that sets it. A field locked by its own variable names that variable; a field another setting forces names the variable of that setting (read only)

write_log_files.description: Name of the variable that locks the write log files: LOGROTATE, or GOA or CROWDSEC_ENABLED when it forces the field

log_format.description: Name of the variable that locks the log format: NGINX_LOG_FORMAT

tls_handshake_log.description: Name of the variable that locks the tls handshake log: NGINX_TLS_HANDSHAKE_LOG, or LISTEN_PROXY_PROTOCOL_HTTPS when it forces the field

log_rotations.description: Name of the variable that locks the log rotations: LOGROTATIONS

goaccess.description: Name of the variable that locks the goaccess: GOA

goaccess_keep_days.description: Name of the variable that locks the goaccess keep days: GOACLA

goaccess_anonymize.description: Name of the variable that locks the goaccess anonymize: GOACLA

goaccess_drop_query_strings.description: Name of the variable that locks the goaccess drop query strings: GOACLA

goaccess_real_os.description: Name of the variable that locks the goaccess real os: GOACLA

goaccess_resolve_hosts.description: Name of the variable that locks the goaccess resolve hosts: GOACLA

locked_reason.description: Fields locked by the environment variable of another setting (an indirect lock), with the reason: key-size (the key type follows ACME_KEY_SIZE), ocsp-stapling-off (Must-Staple is off because ACME_OCSP_STAPLING turns OCSP stapling off), must-staple (OCSP stapling is required by ACME_MUST_STAPLE), goaccess (GoAccess, turned on by GOA, reads the log files), goaccess-setting (GoAccess, turned on by the GoAccess report setting, reads the log files: not an env lock), crowdsec (CrowdSec, turned on by CROWDSEC_ENABLED, reads the log files), crowdsec-setting (CrowdSec, turned on in Settings, CrowdSec, reads the log files: not an env lock), proxy-protocol (the TLS handshake log is off while LISTEN_PROXY_PROTOCOL_HTTPS is on, since a handshake line would name the load balancer). Fields locked by their own variable are not listed.

write_log_files.description: Why the write log files is locked by another setting's variable: goaccess or goaccess-setting (GoAccess is on) or crowdsec or crowdsec-setting (CrowdSec is on)

tls_handshake_log.description: Why the tls handshake log is locked by another setting's variable: proxy-protocol, when LISTEN_PROXY_PROTOCOL_HTTPS is on

applies.description: When a change of each field takes effect

write_log_files.description: When a change of the write log files takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

log_format.description: When a change of the log format takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

tls_handshake_log.description: When a change of the tls handshake log takes effect: on save, with an nginx reload

log_rotations.description: When a change of the log rotations takes effect: on save

goaccess.description: When a change of the goaccess takes effect: after a container restart

goaccess_keep_days.description: When a change of the goaccess keep days takes effect: after a container restart

goaccess_anonymize.description: When a change of the goaccess anonymize takes effect: after a container restart

goaccess_drop_query_strings.description: When a change of the goaccess drop query strings takes effect: after a container restart

goaccess_real_os.description: When a change of the goaccess real os takes effect: after a container restart

goaccess_resolve_hosts.description: When a change of the goaccess resolve hosts takes effect: after a container restart

restart_pending.description: Settings that apply after a container restart (applies restart) saved with another value than the container runs with: restart the container to apply them
